thread.title: Oppenheimer Research Analysts Lower Earnings Estimates for Apple Inc. (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Oppenheimer Research Analysts Lower Earnings Estimates for Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: oppenheimer research analysts lower earnings estimates for apple inc.

text: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Equities research analysts at Oppenheimer lowered their Q2 2019 earnings per share estimates for Apple in a research note issued to investors Oppenheimer analyst A. Uerkwitz now anticipates that the iPhone maker will earn $2.38 per share for the quarter, down from their prior forecast of $2.57. Oppenheimer also issued estimates for Apple’s Q3 2019 earnings at $2.19 EPS.
